run_rotation_transform_tests: run the unittest suite to test RotationTransform image and coordinate rotation at various angles
test_rotation_180: test the RotationTransform class by rotating an image 180 degrees and verifying flipped output
test_rotation_90: test the RotationTransform class by rotating an image 90 degrees and verifying transposed output
test_rotation_coords: test the RotationTransform apply_coords method to verify coordinate transformation at 45 degree rotation
test_inverse_rotation: test the RotationTransform inverse method to verify that inverse rotation restores original image and coords
